digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and threshold lookup
propositions: Model-emitted criteria labels 'sec' (8 instances) and 'documentation' (5 instances) are unmapped synonyms of packaged criteria 'security' and 'docs' respectively, causing them to fall to default 0.95 threshold instead of their criterion's tuned value

Criteria dimension vocabulary is open by design; labels not in the packaged routing index are often legitimately open dimensions or project-supplied criteria that should pass through unmodified, never be dropped or treated as errors

The calibration document incorrectly characterizes 'sec' as non-LLM-tunable and misrepresents data hygiene findings across five specific locations, all stemming from comparison against the packaged index rather than the effective vocabulary

A synonym normalization step must be applied before threshold lookup in code_review_decide to ensure canonical criterion IDs are used for routing decisions, while preserving pass-through behavior for open dimensions and project criteria
